design_archetype: The Performance Pro + Organic & Earthy (Night-Shift Operator)
vibe_direction: Industrial control panel meets farm-tech. Serious operational tool but alive and caring (Mother Hen). High contrast, big glanceable numbers, traffic-light coloring.

typography.heading: Chivo
rules: Use IBM Plex Mono for all sensor readings and big glanceable numbers.
Headings must use Chivo with tracking-tight.
Overlines/Labels must be uppercase, tiny (text-xs), wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6 for dense data.
Shed Tiles: Use border-collapse style layout (Grid Borders technical look) where possible, exposing the skeleton.
Optical Alignment: Left-align labels and values for fast scanning.
Big Glanceable Numbers: text-4xl or 5xl for primary metrics like Temp, Ammonia, Mortality.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-white/5 or border-[#2E2B27]), no shadow. Dark mode only.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.ai_panel: The 'Tracing Beam' or subtle 'Glassmorphism' with heavy amber tint (bg-amber-950/20 border-amber-900/50) to distinguish Mother Hen from standard mechanical data.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.header: Solid background with a hard bottom border. No transparency over scrolling content.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.interactive: Neumorphism (Tactile) variant for toggles/switches (dark clay feel with sharp inner contrast).

shadcn_customizations: Remove heavy rounded corners. Use rounded-sm or max 4px radius for industrial feel.
Tabs: Make them look like physical hardware toggles or sharp bordered segments.
Switch: Use traffic light colors depending on state.
Badge: Sharp edges, dense padding (px-2 py-0.5 text-xs).
components.charts: Recharts for batch history. Temp/Humidity/Water with a dashed line representing the 'Breed Benchmark Overlay'.

motion_and_interactions.ai_motif: Mother Hen status needs a slow 'breathing' or pulse animation using framer-motion to feel 'alive'. Soft amber glow.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Explicit text color on hover. Subtle bg lightening. No wild transforms.
motion_and_interactions.loading: ASCII art loaders or matrix-like data cascading for industrial vibe.

image_urls.description: Dimly lit barn window at night, good for subtle ambient background or login screen.
Cluster of glowing amber orbs on black background. Use as the avatar or visual representation of the AI.
Black and white close-up of a chicken, fits the dark industrial theme perfectly.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast standards are met. Deep background with high brightness text. Color-blind friendly status colors (use icons + text, not just color).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='shed-tile-status', data-testid='ai-decision-log').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: @phosphor-icons/react, recharts, framer-motion, sonner.
Use dark theme by default, hardcoded to dark mode (remove light mode variants if easier, or force dark classes).
Implement the 'Global Dashboard' as the landing view. Grid of sheds with traffic lights.
In the Shed Detail view, make it look like a modernized SCADA screen. Lots of data points: Temp, Airflow, Damper %, etc., neatly aligned in grids.
The 'Mother Hen AI Panel' should be a distinct section or sidebar. Use the amber glowing orb image or CSS animations to indicate 'She is watching'.
Charts must include a breed benchmark overlay (dashed line) comparing actual data to standard breed curve.
Use IBM Plex Mono for all numerical data values to ensure they are highly readable and align well vertically.
DO NOT use a generic SaaS layout. It must feel like an industrial control panel.
Ensure all components use the provided color palette (Obsidian base, Terracotta/Amber accents).
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, tabs, charts, and key data points.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js or .tsx.
